notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around the standard ownership-query callback family. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, multi-attribute FOM, standard MIM, logical-time implementation, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies mixed owned/unowned query partitions on an application object and an RTI-owned query result on a joined-federate MOM object, including suppression and release of informAttributeOwnership, attributeIsNotOwned, and attributeIsOwnedByRTI callbacks, callback-model servicing, exact ownership metadata, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador createFederationExecutionWithMIM plus callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with queryAttributeOwnership and FederateAmbassador informAttributeOwnership/attributeIsNotOwned/attributeIsOwnedByRTI delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador callback-control and ownership-query declarations
